learnings: API errors on non-critical files (like .gitignore) should not cascade to an inconclusive package verdict when the critical files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO) are successfully reviewed and found safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file could not be reviewed due to tool error' and 'file is inconclusive due to security concerns' in the final verdict calculation
For VCS packages, the primary security focus should be on the PKGBUILD's source array, build functions, and any patches - all of which were correctly identified as safe by both models
